Lean emphasizes streamlining operations and improving flow to reduce non-value-added activities.Six Sigma: Six Sigma is a data-driven methodology that aims to reduce variation and defects in processes. This customer-centric approach can help companies retain and expand their customer base.Competitive Advantage: Companies that adopt Lean Six Sigma can gain a competitive edge by consistently delivering better quality products or services at lower costs.Waste Reduction: Lean principles address various forms of waste, such as time, materials, and human resources, making operations more environmentally friendly.Change Management: Implementing Lean Six Sigma requires a culture of continuous improvement, which fosters adaptability and innovation within a company.How the knowledge area of Business Process Optimization with Lean Six Sigma may support building a career:In-Demand Skill: Expertise in Lean Six Sigma is highly sought after in various industries.
